source: SFD-ADNet: Spatial-Frequency Dual-Domain Adaptive Deformation for Point Cloud Data Augmentation
authors: Jiacheng Bao, Lingjun Kong, Wenju Wang
protocol: Ren et al. 2022 mCE (7 corruptions x 5 severities, DGCNN-normalized)
notes: Training-time augmentation only; zero inference overhead.
Built on OpenPoints pipeline; not pluggable into the voxel/HCO stack (verified earlier).
On ModelNet40-C / PointNet++ backbone their own table has Wolfmix (64.1) and AdaptPoint (63.7) better than SFD-ADNet (84.5); SOTA claim rests on PointNeXt (67.2) and ScanObjectNN-C (75.6).
Training cost: 3.8 -> 7.2 min/epoch (+89%), peak 9.6 -> 10.8 GB on RTX 3070.
